greek: Καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων
hint: The lord speaks to Moses.

notes.text: Saying: what follows is the speech, through 31:17.

reading: And [[talked|talked, chatted, prattled, babbled, said, talked of, spoke, chattered, chirped|λαλέω]] [[lord|lord / master, the head, master, the Lord, Jehovah|κύριος]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[name:Μωυσῆν]] [[saying|saying, speaking, declaring, calling by name, telling|λέγω]]

names.gloss: (Μωυσῆς, from Hebrew Mōšeh, which the Hebrew of 2:10 hears in māšâ, "to draw out")

greek: Εἰπὸν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ, καὶ λάβετέ μοι ἀπαρχὰς παρὰ πάντων, οἷς ἂν δόξῃ τῇ καρδίᾳ, καὶ λήμψεσθε τὰς ἀπαρχάς μου.
hint: Israel is to bring offerings from everyone whose heart is willing.

notes.text: To whom ever it may seem good in heart, δοκέω: the Hebrew has ʾăšer yiddĕbennû libbô, whose heart moves him.
ἀπαρχή, beginnings of a sacrifice, first-fruits, for the Hebrew tĕrûmâ, a contribution.

reading: [[say|say, speak, declare, call by name, tell|λέγω]] to the sons of [[name:Ισραηλ]], and [[take|take, receive, take hold of and grasp and seize|λαμβάνω]] to me [[beginnings of a sacrifice|beginnings of a sacrifice and primal offerings, firstlings, first-fruits|ἀπαρχή]] [[from the side of|from the side of, from beside, from, near|παρά + genitive]] [[of all|of all, of the whole, of every, of every single|πᾶς]], to whom ever [[may think|may think, may suppose, may imagine, may expect, may have and form an opinion, may be determined and resolved, may seem and pretend, may seem, may seem good|δοκέω]] [[to the heart|to the heart, to the stomach|καρδία]], and [[you will take|you will take, you will receive, you will take hold of and grasp and seize|λαμβάνω]] [[the beginnings of a sacrifice|the beginnings of a sacrifice and primal offerings, the firstlings, the first-fruits|ἀπαρχή]] of me.

names.gloss: (Ισραηλ, from Hebrew Yiśrāʾēl, which the Hebrew of Genesis 32:29 hears in śārâ ʿim ʾĕlōhîm, "he strove with God")

greek: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἀπαρχή, ἣν λήμψεσθε παρʼ αὐτῶν· χρυσίον καὶ ἀργύριον καὶ χαλκὸν
hint: The offering is to be gold, silver and bronze.

notes.text: Accusatives, what is to be taken, after the high stop: χαλκόν shows the case.

reading: and [[this|this, the nearer, what follows|οὗτος]] is [[the beginning of a sacrifice|the beginning of a sacrifice and primal offering, the firstlings, the first-fruits|ἀπαρχή]], which [[you will take|you will take, you will receive, you will take hold of and grasp and seize|λαμβάνω]] [[from the side of|from the side of, from beside, from, near|παρά + genitive]] of them; [[piece of gold|piece of gold, gold, gold coin and money|χρυσίον]] and [[piece of silver|piece of silver and silver coin, money and sum of money and cash, silver|ἀργύριον]] and [[copper|copper, metal, bronze, anything made of brass and metal, a copper and caldron and urn, a brasen mirror, a copper coin|χαλκός]]

greek: καὶ ὑάκινθον καὶ πορφύραν καὶ κόκκινον διπλοῦν καὶ βύσσον κεκλωσμένην καὶ τρίχας αἰγείας
hint: The materials go on: blue, purple and doubled scarlet, spun linen and goats' hair.

notes.text: ὑάκινθος, the hyacinth, and the sapphire; the entry's prose on the flower's dark colours is not a translation of the word, and its jacinth is negated.
Doubled scarlet: the Hebrew has tôlaʿat šānî, crimson worm.
κόκκινος, scarlet, one translation, plain text.

reading: and [[hyacinth|hyacinth, sapphire|ὑάκινθος]] and [[purple-fish|purple-fish, purple dye and purple, purple raiment|πορφύρα]] and scarlet [[twofold|twofold and double, double-minded and treacherous|διπλοῦς]] and [[a fine flax|a fine flax, linen made from it|βύσσος]] [[having been twisted by spinning|having been twisted by spinning and spun and standing so|κλώθω]] and [[hairs of the head|hairs of the head, wool, bristles, single hairs|θρίξ]] [[of a goat|of a goat and goats, a goat's, of goatskin|αἴγειος]]

greek: καὶ δέρματα κριῶν ἠρυθροδανωμένα καὶ δέρματα ὑακίνθινα καὶ ξύλα ἄσηπτα
hint: Rams' skins dyed red, blue skins and wood that does not rot.

notes.text: ἐρυθροδανόω, not in Middle Liddell: LSJ's dye with madder, dye red, citing this verse.
Woods not liable to decay, ἄσηπτος, for the Hebrew ʿăṣê šiṭṭîm, acacia wood; LSJ's of Acacia tortilis is the phrase's, set aside.
Hyacinthine skins, for the Hebrew ʿōrōt tĕḥāšîm, of uncertain meaning.
Rahlfs prints no verse 6: the Hebrew's oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil and the incense, are not in this text.

reading: and [[skins|skins, hides, skins prepared for bags and bottles|δέρμα]] [[of rams|of rams, of battering-rams|κριός]] [[having been dyed with madder|having been dyed with madder and dyed red and standing so|ἐρυθροδανόω]] and [[skins|skins, hides, skins prepared for bags and bottles|δέρμα]] hyacinthine and [[woods|woods, firewood, timbers, pieces of wood and posts, sticks|ξύλον]] [[not liable to decay|not liable to decay and corruption, undigested|ἄσηπτος]]

greek: καὶ λίθους σαρδίου καὶ λίθους εἰς τὴν γλυφὴν εἰς τὴν ἐπωμίδα καὶ τὸν ποδήρη.
hint: Carnelian and stones for carving, for the shoulder-piece and the long robe.

notes.text: Stones of Sardian stone, carnelian: the Hebrew has ʾabnê-šōham, onyx stones.
γλυφή, not in Middle Liddell: LSJ's carving, carved work.
ποδήρης, reaching to the feet, used as a noun; the examples' frock and shield set aside.

reading: and [[stones|stones, precious stones, marbles|λίθος]] [[of Sardian stone|of Sardian stone and carnelian|σάρδιον]] and [[stones|stones, precious stones, marbles|λίθος]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the carving|the carving and carved work, the emblem and device, the work, the hole cut|γλυφή]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the point of the shoulder|the point of the shoulder, the acromion, the shoulder, the front, the uppermost part of a ship, the shoulder-strap|ἐπωμίς]] and [[the reaching to the feet|the reaching to the feet, the straight and firm|ποδήρης]].

greek: καὶ ποιήσεις μοι ἁγίασμα, καὶ ὀφθήσομαι ἐν ὑμῖν·
hint: A sanctuary is to be made, and the lord will appear among the people.

notes.text: I will be seen in you: the Hebrew has wĕšākantî bĕtôkām, I will dwell among them.
ἐν before a pronoun takes its own unit.

reading: and [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]] to me [[holy place|holy place and sanctuary, holiness|ἁγίασμα]], and [[I will be seen|I will be seen, I will be looked at, I will be beheld and perceived and observed, I will be looked out for|ὁράω]] [[in|within, inside of, and by means of|ἐν]] to you;

greek: καὶ ποιήσεις μοι κατὰ πάντα, ὅσα ἐγώ σοι δεικνύω ἐν τῷ ὄρει, τὸ παράδειγμα τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ τὸ παράδειγμα πάντων τῶν σκευῶν αὐτῆς· οὕτω ποιήσεις.
hint: Everything is to follow the pattern shown on the mountain, for the tent and all its furnishings.

notes.text: In the mountain: not in the Hebrew of this verse; the Greek takes it from 25:40.
παράδειγμα, a pattern or model, for the Hebrew tabnît.

reading: and [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]] to me [[down|down, downwards, down from, down upon, over, upon|κατά + accusative]] [[all|all, the whole, every, every single|πᾶς]], [[as great as|as great as, as much as, as far as, as long as, as many as|ὅσος]] I to you [[I bring to light|I bring to light and display and exhibit, I set before one, I show and point out, I tell and explain and teach, I show and prove, I inform against, I offer and proffer, I cause, I welcome and greet and pledge|δείκνυμι]] [[in the mountain|within, inside of, and by means of the mountain and hill|ἐν; ὄρος]], [[the pattern|the pattern, the model, the plan, the precedent and example, the example, the lesson, the warning, the argument and proof from example, the copy|παράδειγμα]] [[of the covered place|of the covered place and tent, of the camp, of the dwelling-place, of the temple|σκηνή]] and [[the pattern|the pattern, the model, the plan, the precedent and example, the example, the lesson, the warning, the argument and proof from example, the copy|παράδειγμα]] [[of all|of all, of the whole, of every, of every single|πᾶς]] [[of the vessels|of the vessels, of the implements of any kind, of the furniture and house-gear and utensils and chattels, of the accoutrements and equipment, of the baggage and luggage, of the tackling, of the gear, of the inanimate objects and things, of the bodies and vessels|σκεῦος]] of her; [[in this way|in this way, in this manner, so, thus, even so, so much|οὕτως]] [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]].

greek: Καὶ ποιήσεις κιβωτὸν μαρτυρίου ἐκ ξύλων ἀσήπτων, δύο πήχεων καὶ ἡμίσους τὸ μῆκος καὶ πήχεος καὶ ἡμίσους τὸ πλάτος καὶ πήχεος καὶ ἡμίσους τὸ ὕψος.
hint: An ark of the testimony, of rot-proof wood, two and a half cubits long and one and a half wide and high.

notes.text: A wooden box of testimony: the Hebrew has only ʾărôn, an ark; of testimony is the Greek's.
ἥμισυς, half, genitive with the cubit understood.

notes.lemma: τὸ μῆκος … τὸ πλάτος … τὸ ὕψος
notes.text: Accusatives of respect, as to the length.

reading: And [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]] [[a wooden box|a wooden box and chest and coffer|κιβωτός]] [[of a testimony|of a testimony and proof|μαρτύριον]] [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] [[of woods|of woods, of firewood, of timbers, of pieces of wood and posts, of sticks|ξύλον]] [[of not liable to decay|of not liable to decay and corruption, of undigested|ἄσηπτος]], of two [[of fore-arms|of fore-arms, of arms, of centrepieces of the bow, of horns and sides of the lyre, of cubits and ells, of cubit-rules|πῆχυς]] and [[of half|of half, of half of, of one half|ἥμισυς]] [[the length|the length, the distances, the height and tallness and stature|μῆκος]] and [[of fore-arm|of fore-arm, of arm, of centrepiece of the bow, of horn and side of the lyre, of cubit and ell, of cubit-rule|πῆχυς]] and [[of half|of half, of half of, of one half|ἥμισυς]] [[the breadth|the breadth and width|πλάτος]] and [[of fore-arm|of fore-arm, of arm, of centrepiece of the bow, of horn and side of the lyre, of cubit and ell, of cubit-rule|πῆχυς]] and [[of half|of half, of half of, of one half|ἥμισυς]] [[the height|the height, the top and summit and crown|ὕψος]].

greek: καὶ καταχρυσώσεις αὐτὴν χρυσίῳ καθαρῷ, ἔξωθεν καὶ ἔσωθεν χρυσώσεις αὐτήν· καὶ ποιήσεις αὐτῇ κυμάτια στρεπτὰ χρυσᾶ κύκλῳ.
hint: The ark is overlaid with pure gold inside and out, with twisted gold mouldings round it.

notes.text: κυμάτιον, not in Middle Liddell: LSJ's Dim. of κῦμα I.3, read as that sense, waved moulding, cyma, with its own volute and groove.
Twisted mouldings, plural: the Hebrew has zēr, a rim, singular.

reading: and [[you will cover with gold-leaf|you will cover with gold-leaf and gild, you will make golden|καταχρυσόω]] her [[to a piece of gold|to a piece of gold, to gold, to gold coin and money|χρυσίον]] [[to clear of dirt|to clear of dirt and clean and spotless and unsoiled, to clear and open and free, to clear from shame and pollution and pure, to clear of guilt and defilement and clean and pure, to purified, to clear of and from, to clear of admixture and clear and pure, to pure and genuine, to without blemish, to clear and exact|καθαρός]], [[from without|from without, outside, without and free from|ἔξωθεν]] and [[from within|from within, within|ἔσωθεν]] [[you will make golden|you will make golden and gild|χρυσόω]] her; and [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]] to her [[waved mouldings|waved mouldings and cymas, volutes, grooves|κυμάτιον]] [[flexible|flexible and pliant, of chain-armour, twined and wreathed, to be bent and turned, glib and pliant, bent and curved|στρεπτός]] [[golden|golden, of gold, decked and inlaid with gold, gilded and gilt, gold-coloured and golden-yellow|χρυσοῦς]] [[in a circle|in a circle, in a ring and round about|κύκλῳ]].

greek: καὶ ἐλάσεις αὐτῇ τέσσαρας δακτυλίους χρυσοῦς καὶ ἐπιθήσεις ἐπὶ τὰ τέσσαρα κλίτη, δύο δακτυλίους ἐπὶ τὸ κλίτος τὸ ἓν καὶ δύο δακτυλίους ἐπὶ τὸ κλίτος τὸ δεύτερον.
hint: Four gold rings are fixed on the ark's four sides, two on each side.

notes.text: ἐλαύνω, to drive, set in motion; to beat with a hammer, to beat out metal, is among its senses. The passive's to go through left to the passive.
κλίτος, = κλίμα II, a clime, one translation, plain text.
The four sides: the Hebrew has paʿămōtāyw, its four feet.

reading: and [[you will drive|you will drive and drive on and set in motion, you will drive, you will ride, you will row, you will go in a chariot and drive, you will travel, you will march, you will sail, you will run, you will drive away, you will drive away and expel, you will drive to extremities, you will persecute and attack and harass, you will push on and go on, you will strike, you will drive and thrust through, you will beat with a hammer, you will draw a line of wall and a trench, you will work your way, you will draw, you will plant them in line, you will prolong|ἐλαύνω]] to her four [[rings|rings and seal-rings|δακτύλιος]] [[golden|golden, of gold, decked and inlaid with gold, gilded and gilt, gold-coloured and golden-yellow|χρυσοῦς]] and [[you will lay|you will lay, you will put, you will place upon, you will apply, you will set up, you will put on, you will put to and shut, you will put to and grant and give besides, you will add and bring on, you will impose and inflict, you will dispatch, you will give|ἐπιτίθημι]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + accusative]] the four climes, two [[rings|rings and seal-rings|δακτύλιος]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + accusative]] the clime [[the one|the one, the single one and one alone|εἷς]] and two [[rings|rings and seal-rings|δακτύλιος]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + accusative]] the clime [[the second|the second, the one coming in second, the next best, the next, the one after, the secondly and next and afterwards and a second time, the second time, the secondary, the second of two|δεύτερος]].

greek: ποιήσεις δὲ ἀναφορεῖς ξύλα ἄσηπτα καὶ καταχρυσώσεις αὐτὰ χρυσίῳ·
hint: Carrying poles of the same wood, overlaid with gold.

notes.text: ἀναφορεύς, not in Middle Liddell: LSJ's bearer, bearing-pole, citing this verse.

reading: [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[bearers|bearers and bearing-poles|ἀναφορεύς]] [[woods|woods, firewood, timbers, pieces of wood and posts, sticks|ξύλον]] [[not liable to decay|not liable to decay and corruption, undigested|ἄσηπτος]] and [[you will cover with gold-leaf|you will cover with gold-leaf and gild, you will make golden|καταχρυσόω]] them [[to a piece of gold|to a piece of gold, to gold, to gold coin and money|χρυσίον]];

greek: καὶ εἰσάξεις τοὺς ἀναφορεῖς εἰς τοὺς δακτυλίους τοὺς ἐν τοῖς κλίτεσι τῆς κιβωτοῦ αἴρειν τὴν κιβωτὸν ἐν αὐτοῖς·
hint: The poles go through the rings so the ark can be carried.

notes.text: The article over a phrase carries its noun, the ones, masculine with the rings.

reading: and [[you will lead in|you will lead in, you will lead into and introduce, you will admit, you will import, you will call in, you will bring in and bring forward|εἰσάγω]] [[the bearers|the bearers and bearing-poles|ἀναφορεύς]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the rings|the rings and seal-rings|δακτύλιος]] the ones [[in|within, inside of, and by means of|ἐν]] to the climes [[of the wooden box|of the wooden box and chest and coffer|κιβωτός]] [[to take up|to take up and raise and lift up, to bear and sustain, to raise up and exalt, to excite, to extol and exaggerate, to lift and take away and remove, to take off and kill|αἴρω]] [[the wooden box|the wooden box and chest and coffer|κιβωτός]] [[in|within, inside of, and by means of|ἐν]] to them;

greek: ἐν τοῖς δακτυλίοις τῆς κιβωτοῦ ἔσονται οἱ ἀναφορεῖς ἀκίνητοι.
hint: The poles stay in the rings, unmoved.

notes.text: Unmoved: the Hebrew has lōʾ yāsūrû mimmennû, they shall not be removed from it.

reading: [[in the rings|within, inside of, and by means of the rings and seal-rings|ἐν; δακτύλιος]] [[of the wooden box|of the wooden box and chest and coffer|κιβωτός]] will be [[the bearers|the bearers and bearing-poles|ἀναφορεύς]] [[unmoved|unmoved and motionless, idle and sluggish, unmoved and unaltered, immovable and hard to move, not to be stirred and touched and inviolate, not to be shaken and steadfast and stubborn|ἀκίνητος]].

greek: καὶ ἐμβαλεῖς εἰς τὴν κιβωτὸν τὰ μαρτύρια, ἃ ἂν δῶ σοι.
hint: The testimony the lord gives is placed in the ark.

notes.text: The testimonies, plural: the Hebrew has hāʿēdut, the testimony.

reading: and [[you will throw in|you will throw in, you will put in, you will throw at and upon and against, you will inflict, you will apply, you will make an inroad and invasion, you will break and burst and rush in, you will strike a ship with the ram and charge it|ἐμβάλλω]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the wooden box|the wooden box and chest and coffer|κιβωτός]] [[the testimonies|the testimonies and proofs|μαρτύριον]], which ever [[I may give|I may give, I may grant, I may provide, I may give over and deliver up|δίδωμι]] to you.

greek: καὶ ποιήσεις ἱλαστήριον ἐπίθεμα χρυσίου καθαροῦ, δύο πήχεων καὶ ἡμίσους τὸ μῆκος καὶ πήχεος καὶ ἡμίσους τὸ πλάτος.
hint: A mercy seat, a cover of pure gold, two and a half cubits by one and a half.

notes.text: A mercy-seat, a cover: the Hebrew has only kappōret; the Greek gives the thing and its use.
ἱλαστήριον, filed inside the adjective ἱλαστήριος: as a noun, the mercy-seat, a propitiation.
ἐπίθεμα, not in Middle Liddell: LSJ's = ἐπίθημα, cover, citing this verse, and its other senses.

reading: and [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]] [[mercy-seat|mercy-seat, a propitiation|ἱλαστήριον]] [[cover|cover, capital, remedy for external application, addition, higher bid, shaft|ἐπίθεμα]] [[of piece of gold|of piece of gold, of gold, of gold coin and money|χρυσίον]] [[of clear of dirt|of clear of dirt and clean and spotless and unsoiled, of clear and open and free, of clear from shame and pollution and pure, of clear of guilt and defilement and clean and pure, of purified, of clear of and from, of clear of admixture and clear and pure, of pure and genuine, of without blemish, of clear and exact|καθαρός]], of two [[of fore-arms|of fore-arms, of arms, of centrepieces of the bow, of horns and sides of the lyre, of cubits and ells, of cubit-rules|πῆχυς]] and [[of half|of half, of half of, of one half|ἥμισυς]] [[the length|the length, the distances, the height and tallness and stature|μῆκος]] and [[of fore-arm|of fore-arm, of arm, of centrepiece of the bow, of horn and side of the lyre, of cubit and ell, of cubit-rule|πῆχυς]] and [[of half|of half, of half of, of one half|ἥμισυς]] [[the breadth|the breadth and width|πλάτος]].

greek: καὶ ποιήσεις δύο χερουβιμ χρυσᾶ τορευτὰ καὶ ἐπιθήσεις αὐτὰ ἐξ ἀμφοτέρων τῶν κλιτῶν τοῦ ἱλαστηρίου·
hint: Two cherubim of hammered gold stand at the two ends of the mercy seat.

notes.text: A transliteration Rahlfs prints in lower case, a name here, as at Genesis 3:24; neuter in this verse, with χρυσᾶ τορευτά.
τορευτός, worked in relief, for the Hebrew miqšâ, hammered work.

reading: and [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]] two [[name:χερουβιμ]] [[golden|golden, of gold, decked and inlaid with gold, gilded and gilt, gold-coloured and golden-yellow|χρυσοῦς]] [[worked in relief|worked in relief, elaborate|τορευτός]] and [[you will lay|you will lay, you will put, you will place upon, you will apply, you will set up, you will put on, you will put to and shut, you will put to and grant and give besides, you will add and bring on, you will impose and inflict, you will dispatch, you will give|ἐπιτίθημι]] them [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] [[of each|of each, of both of two|ἀμφότερος]] of the climes [[of the mercy-seat|of the mercy-seat, of the propitiation|ἱλαστήριον]];

names.gloss: (χερουβιμ, the Hebrew plural kĕrûbîm, of kĕrûb, a word of uncertain derivation)

greek: ποιηθήσονται χερουβ εἷς ἐκ τοῦ κλίτους τούτου καὶ χερουβ εἷς ἐκ τοῦ κλίτους τοῦ δευτέρου τοῦ ἱλαστηρίου· καὶ ποιήσεις τοὺς δύο χερουβιμ ἐπὶ τὰ δύο κλίτη.
hint: One cherub at each end; the two are set on the two sides.

notes.text: The Hebrew singular, transliterated, masculine with εἷς.
They will be made, plural, with a singular subject twice over.

reading: [[they will be made|they will be made, they will be done, they will be produced, they will be created|ποιέω]] [[name:χερουβ]] [[one|one, a single one and one alone|εἷς]] [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] of the clime [[of this|of this, of the nearer, of what follows|οὗτος]] and [[name:χερουβ]] [[one|one, a single one and one alone|εἷς]] [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] of the clime [[of the second|of the second, of the one coming in second, of the next best, of the next, of the one after, of the secondly and next and afterwards and a second time, of the second time, of the secondary, of the second of two|δεύτερος]] [[of the mercy-seat|of the mercy-seat, of the propitiation|ἱλαστήριον]]; and [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]] the two [[name:χερουβιμ]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + accusative]] the two climes.

names.gloss: (χερουβ, from Hebrew kĕrûb, a word of uncertain derivation)

greek: ἔσονται οἱ χερουβιμ ἐκτείνοντες τὰς πτέρυγας ἐπάνωθεν, συσκιάζοντες ταῖς πτέρυξιν αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τοῦ ἱλαστηρίου, καὶ τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν εἰς ἄλληλα· εἰς τὸ ἱλαστήριον ἔσονται τὰ πρόσωπα τῶν χερουβιμ.
hint: The cherubim spread their wings above, shading the mercy seat, and face one another and the mercy seat.

notes.text: ἀλλήλων, one another, one translation, plain text.
ἐπάνωθεν, from above, above; its men of former time a phrase's.

notes.text: φαίνω, the future active: to bring to light, make to appear, and absolutely to give light; the middle's and the passive's senses left to them.
From the one face: the Hebrew has ʿal-ʿēber pānêhā, over against its front.

reading: and [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]] [[the portable lights|the portable lights and lamps, the lamp-market|λύχνος]] of her seven; and [[you will lay|you will lay, you will put, you will place upon, you will apply, you will set up, you will put on, you will put to and shut, you will put to and grant and give besides, you will add and bring on, you will impose and inflict, you will dispatch, you will give|ἐπιτίθημι]] [[the portable lights|the portable lights and lamps, the lamp-market|λύχνος]], and [[they will bring to light|they will bring to light and make to appear, they will show forth and make known and reveal and disclose and show, they will make it clear, they will make it ring clear, they will make clear and explain and expound, they will inform against, they will indict and impeach, they will inform of as contraband, they will give information, they will proclaim, they will call out, they will give light|φαίνω]] [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] [[of the one|of the one, of the single one and one alone|εἷς]] [[of face|of face and visage and countenance, of look, of mask, of outward appearance|πρόσωπον]].

greek: καὶ τὸν ἐπαρυστῆρα αὐτῆς καὶ τὰ ὑποθέματα αὐτῆς ἐκ χρυσίου καθαροῦ ποιήσεις.
hint: Its oil-pourer and stands are also of pure gold.

notes.text: ἐπαρυστήρ, not in Middle Liddell: LSJ's vessel for pouring oil into a lamp, citing this verse; the Hebrew has malqāḥêhā, its tongs.
ὑπόθεμα, not in Middle Liddell: LSJ's = ὑπόθημα, base, one translation, plain text.

reading: and the vessel for pouring oil into a lamp of her and the bases of her [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] [[of piece of gold|of piece of gold, of gold, of gold coin and money|χρυσίον]] [[of clear of dirt|of clear of dirt and clean and spotless and unsoiled, of clear and open and free, of clear from shame and pollution and pure, of clear of guilt and defilement and clean and pure, of purified, of clear of and from, of clear of admixture and clear and pure, of pure and genuine, of without blemish, of clear and exact|καθαρός]] [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]].

greek: πάντα τὰ σκεύη ταῦτα τάλαντον χρυσίου καθαροῦ.
hint: All these vessels together weigh a talent of pure gold.

notes.text: τάλαντον, a balance, anything weighed, a talent; the plural's a pair of scales left to the plural.
A verbless clause, nominative.

reading: [[all|all, the whole, every, every single|πᾶς]] [[the vessels|the vessels, the implements of any kind, the furniture and house-gear and utensils and chattels, the accoutrements and equipment, the baggage and luggage, the tackling, the gear, the inanimate objects and things, the bodies and vessels|σκεῦος]] [[these|these, the nearer, what follows|οὗτος]] [[a balance|a balance, anything weighed, a definite weight and a talent, a weight, a sum of money|τάλαντον]] [[of piece of gold|of piece of gold, of gold, of gold coin and money|χρυσίον]] [[of clear of dirt|of clear of dirt and clean and spotless and unsoiled, of clear and open and free, of clear from shame and pollution and pure, of clear of guilt and defilement and clean and pure, of purified, of clear of and from, of clear of admixture and clear and pure, of pure and genuine, of without blemish, of clear and exact|καθαρός]].

greek: ὅρα ποιήσεις κατὰ τὸν τύπον τὸν δεδειγμένον σοι ἐν τῷ ὄρει.
hint: Everything is to follow the model shown on the mountain.

notes.text: τύπος, a blow, the print or impress of it, and so a figure, form, model; Middle Liddell's first sense heads.
See, you will make: the imperative with the future, for the Hebrew rĕʾēh waʿăśēh, see and make.

reading: [[see|see, perceive, behold, look at|ὁράω]] [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]] [[down|down, downwards, down from, down upon, over, upon|κατά + accusative]] [[the blow|the blow, the effect of a blow and print, the impress, the sound of their tread, the anything wrought of metal and stone, the figure and image and statue, the form, the general form, the character and type, the model, the example, the outline and sketch and draught|τύπος]] [[the one having been brought to light|the one having been brought to light and displayed and exhibited and standing so, the one having been set before one, the one having been shown and pointed out, the one having been told and explained and taught, the one having been shown and proved, the one having been informed against, the one having been offered and proffered, the one having been caused, the one having been welcomed and greeted and pledged|δείκνυμι]] to you [[in the mountain|within, inside of, and by means of the mountain and hill|ἐν; ὄρος]].
